World War 3

Build a base, harvest supply, capture oil derricks, research upgrades and level the enemy's base by land, sea and air. Units earn ranks from kills, and your general earns points to spend on battlefield powers.

National anthems performed by the United States Navy Band (public domain, via Wikimedia Commons and the Internet Archive): The Star-Spangled Banner, the Anthem of Europe (Beethoven), Hatikvah, Shche ne vmerla Ukrainy, La Bayamesa, Jana Gana Mana (Tagore), March of the Volunteers (Nie Er), Bilady, Bilady, Bilady (Sayed Darwish), Qaumi Taranah (Ahmed G. Chagla), Aegukga (Ahn Eak-tai) and the State Anthem of Russia (Alexander Alexandrov).

Unit voices (every nation speaks its own language, with a light military-radio treatment) generated offline with open speech models: Coqui XTTS-v2 studio voices (Coqui Public Model License, non-commercial) for Arabic, English, French, German, Turkish, Russian, Chinese, Korean, Hindi/Urdu and Spanish; US unit voices are cloned from public-domain American recordings (US government works via the Internet Archive: Dwight D. Eisenhower, farewell address 1961; Ronald Reagan, address to the nation 1981; Harry S. Truman, address to Congress 1945); Piper voices by Rhasspy / Nabu Casa (MIT) — ganji and gyro (Persian), mykyta and oleksa (Ukrainian), saspeech (Hebrew), fasih (Urdu), rohan and pratham (Hindi) — each under its own dataset licence (CC0, Apache-2.0, Unlicense, MIT, or CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for non-commercial use); and Meta MMS-TTS Hebrew (CC BY-NC 4.0, non-commercial).

3D models: T-90 by Yantung77, Toyota Hilux by David_Holiday, Caterpillar D7R by RolandoGarroMena, AH-64 Apache by araon, Mi-24 by anastasia.d, F-15 by salphytheunemployed, F/A-18, Su-35, UH-60 and Mi-8 by manilov.ap, M1 Abrams by Artem.Goyko, Merkava by klopikc, KF51 Panther by GRIP420, 2S19 Msta-S and T-84 Oplot by lm9241221, T-72 by jorasketch, T-62 by jonathanto99, T-55 by SGAstudio, Leopard 2A4 by Aldeveron, Ural-4320 by davidbroutian, M35 truck by zerofrost, Humvee by madtrollstudio, Rafale by harway, Eurofighter Typhoon by nestor_d, J-10 by td991, MiG-29 by Usman1684, F-16 by Carlos.Maciel, G6 by desertfox2, Wiesel 2 Ozelot by Adityakm, Ka-52 and Mi-28 by maddex88, AH-1 Cobra by Shreyash, HMS Dragon destroyer by Miljan Bojic, Russian destroyer by assg709, German F123 frigate by seb201, patrol speedboat by GloriousBritain, attack submarine by Warfare, Foxtrot submarine by 8bit, Sinpo-class submarine by KoreanNavy, Scud launcher truck by PaintedTarget (CC-BY, via Sketchfab/Objaverse); Quaternius, Kenney and Kay Lousberg (public domain); Zsky, KolosStudios, Alex Safayan, angelo raffaele Catalano, jeremy, Jarlan Perez, Poly by Google, J-Toastie, Paul Spooner and sftwr314r8 (CC BY), via Poly Pizza.
